title: Efficient Subgroup Analysis via Optimal Trees with Global Parameter Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2602.04077v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Identifying and making statistical inferences on differential treatment effects (commonly known as subgroup analysis in clinical research) is central to precision health. Subgroup analysis allows practitioners to pinpoint populations for whom a treatment is especially beneficial or protective, thereby advancing targeted interventions. Tree based recursive partitioning methods are widely used for subgroup analysis due to their interpretability. Nevertheless, these approaches encounter significant limitations, including suboptimal partitions induced by greedy heuristics and overfitting from locally estimated splits, especially under limited sample sizes. To address these limitations, we propose a fused optimal causal tree method that leverages mixed integer optimization (MIO) to facilitate precise subgroup identification. translated_title: 通过全局参数融合的最优树实现高效亚组分析
translated_abstract: 识别差异性治疗效应并进行统计推断（在临床研究中通常称为亚组分析）是精准健康的核心。亚组分析使从业者能够精准定位对治疗特别受益或受保护的人群，从而推动针对性干预措施的开展。基于树的递归划分方法因其良好的可解释性而被广泛应用于亚组分析。然而，这些方法存在显著的局限性，包括贪婪启发式算法导致的次优划分，以及局部估计分裂带来的过拟合问题，在样本量有限的情况下尤为突出。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种融合最优因果树方法，利用混合整数优化（MIO）来实现精确的亚组识别。我们的方法确保全局最优划分，并引入参数融合约束以促进[统计推断]。……
tldr: 提出一种基于混合整数优化的融合最优因果树方法，通过全局最优划分与参数融合约束，克服了传统树方法贪婪分裂导致的次优划分和过拟合问题，实现精确的差异性治疗效应亚组识别。
en_tdlr: A fused optimal causal tree method leveraging mixed integer optimization achieves globally optimal partitions with a parameter fusion constraint, overcoming the greedy splitting and overfitting limitations of traditional tree-based subgroup analysis.
